entities.name: Shōtarō Ikenami
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Shōtarō Ikenami  was a Japanese author. He wrote a number of historical novels. He won the Naoki Award for popular literature in 1960. Many of his historical novels were adapted for TV and cinema.
